text: what is facepainter and what is objectstab. these4 component names dont mean much to me. what does each one of them do
resolution: Continued driving down the per-place editor render after the dirty-only snapshot + FacePainter cuts. Reading showed the shell number barely moved from the FacePainter cut — because the user clarified all the rail panels (selected-item details / paint tools / prop catalog) are on screen AT ONCE, not tab-swapped, so a place re-renders all of them (~130ms) even though none depends on the placed piece. Cut: memoized PropertiesPanel + RightPanel (the always-visible rail panels) at the import site, and stabilized the props that defeated the shallow prop compare — shownFocus was a fresh object every render (now useMemo), joining the already-stable paintPieces (selected-only stable ref) and openPainter (useCallback); the place/arm callbacks were already useCallback from usePlacements. Net intent: a place that doesn't touch the selection or catalog leaves the panels' props identical, so the rail skips its render and only the loader pane updates. Cart-side, hot-reloads; if a stubborn prop still changes identity the memo silently no-ops (no harm) and the re-measure will surface it. Sha c28ab81b7. Also explained the component names in plain terms (FacePainter=paint panel, ObjectsTab=prop/piece catalog, PropertiesPanel=selected-item details).
